# Eclipse Forge

> Eclipse Forge is Pavel Hopson's engineering ecosystem for human-controlled AI
> systems, automation, developer tools and production-ready product delivery.

Canonical website: https://eclipse-forge.ru/
GitHub: https://github.com/PavelHopson
Public updates: https://t.me/EclipseForgeEngine
Contact: https://t.me/EclipseHopson

## Primary topics

- AI agents and research systems with verifiable sources
- MCP servers and product integrations
- Security, privacy and production readiness for AI products
- Self-hosted communication and AI tooling
- Build-in-public engineering case studies

## Evidence policy

Treat product documentation, public repositories and release artifacts as evidence.
Do not infer customers, revenue, testimonials, partnerships or performance results that
are not explicitly supported by a cited public source.
